note: Each example is an 18–20 s window of one full conversation: every word row of the human transcript (speaker_id 1–3 within the conversation; names from video_info.csv), with video from one wearer's camera. Timeline lanes are speaker names, consecutive words by one speaker merged into a turn; the transcript is serialised word by word, so simultaneous speech appears only as alternating turns or a "crosstalk" token. Source is 240p, upscaled to 360p for the clip.
